zoe: quick heads-up: onboarding README has three different env var names across snippets (REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_TOKEN, REDWOOD_API_KEY). new users are copy/pasting and getting 401s.

ryan: saw that too. i hit it when testing the sample app. the node sample reads REDWOOD_KEY while the curl uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN. reproducible: set REDWOOD_API_TOKEN -> run node sample -> Authorization header missing -> 401 -> sdk enters retry/backoff and appears to hang.

maya: yikes. small PR idea: pick one canonical name (recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY), update all samples, and replace literal placeholder keys in code with process.env lookups. also add a short "never commit keys" note.

zoe: +1. can we also provide shell-specific curl examples? powershell quoting breaks if we show bash escaping. e.g.:

```
# bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
\n# powershell
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

ryan: suggest we add a tiny troubleshooting section under quickstart: "If requests return 401, verify your env var name and ensure quotes are plain ASCII (smart quotes from docs can sneak in)." also note exponential backoff so folks know retries are expected.

docs-bot: created ticket DOC-934: "quickstart env var consistency + shell snippets" and attached PR template.

maya: i'll open the PR: changes will include 1) unify to REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) update node/python/go samples to read from env 3) add bash/powershell/snippets and labels 4) add a CI grep for sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{10,} in docs.

infra-bot: please add windows runner smoke test to the docs pipeline so we validate powershell snippets.

zoe: QA checklist for PR: unify names, shell labels, no literal keys, run quickstart on mac/linux/windows. ryan can do the windows smoke.

ryan: will run smoke tests and look for leftover placeholders. will also check the examples don't accidentally eval env in the curl snippet (we should avoid $EXPANSION in docs unless labeled).

maya: PR incoming in ~15m. tagging @eng-docs for review. thanks folks :raised_hands:
_meta: devex docs/snippet drift - onboarding env var parity and shell quoting
